Admin.access_scope: Global (All Leads across all Marketing personnel)
capabilities: View all Nasabah and Pelamar Kerja leads
Create new leads and assign to specific Marketing staff or leave unassigned
Reassign or transfer leads from one Marketing staff to another
Manage Marketing user accounts (Create account, set name, email, password, role)
Filter leads by Marketing Owner, Status, Lead Type, and Date Range
View team performance metrics and conversion rates

Marketing.access_scope: Restricted Isolation (Only leads explicitly assigned to current logged-in Marketing user ID)
capabilities: View personal assigned Nasabah and Pelamar Kerja leads queue
Update progress status (e.g. Baru -> Follow Up -> Deal)
Add timestamped progress notes and activity logs to assigned leads
Filter personal leads by Status, Lead Type, and Follow-Up urgency
Cannot view, edit, or search leads assigned to other marketing personnel

Nasabah.description: Leads calon nasabah dan produk keuangan / perbankan

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Indonesian language across all UI elements, labels, buttons, dialogs, status tags, and notification messages (e.g., 'QuickPro Leads CRM', 'Kelola Leads', 'Tugaskan Marketing', 'Tambah Catatan Progres', 'Follow-Up Hari Ini').
Implement session-based authentication with httpOnly cookie endpoint integration in FastAPI backend and frontend `lib/session.ts`.
Seed default users: Admin account (e.g. admin@quickpro.id / admin123) and Marketing accounts (e.g. marketing1@quickpro.id, marketing2@quickpro.id / password123).

Enforce strict data isolation: Marketing role API query must filter `assigned_to == current_user_id`. Backend MUST reject any request where a Marketing user tries to read or modify a lead assigned to another user.

Include sample seed data for both Nasabah (10+ realistic Indonesian customer leads with varied products and statuses) and Pelamar Kerja (10+ realistic applicant leads with varied positions and statuses).
Include follow-up date fields (`tanggal_follow_up`) on leads and prominent notification highlight banners for leads due today or overdue.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive buttons, inputs, filter selects, table rows, and status update submit forms for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Apply targeted transitions like 'transition-colors duration-200'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Maintain clean left-aligned executive reading hierarchy.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, select, and table row (kebab-case format).
Use Sonner for toast notifications on lead creation, status updates, note addition, and lead assignment.
Ensure strict TypeScript compliance with zero type errors (`yarn typecheck`).
